svg.title: Online shock policy action choices
svg.desc: Two aligned heatmaps show skin and neighbor weight selected at each of 120 decisions in episodes 12 through 35. Gray cells are epsilon-random exploration. Later episodes show skin 0.5 early, with some skin 0.7 late, and weight factors moving from 1.2 or 1.5 early to 0.5 late.
svg.text: Each cell = one 500-step decision; gray = epsilon-random, not the greedy policy
